title: Independence number of a lexicographic product
statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be simple graphs on finite vertex sets, and let $G[H]$ denote their composition (lexicographic product): the simple graph with vertex set $V(G) \times V(H)$ in which $(u,v)$ is adjacent to $(u',v')$ exactly when $uu' \in E(G)$, or else $u = u'$ and $vv' \in E(H)$. Writing $\alpha(\cdot)$ for the independence number, the independence number of the composition satisfies \[ \alpha(G[H]) \le \alpha(G)\,\alpha(H). \]
hypotheses_covered: G is a simple graph on a finite vertex set
H is a simple graph on a finite vertex set
